newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel Land seals property sale agreement.
newsitem.headline: Keppel Land seals property sale agreement.

text.p: Keppel Land Ltd said on Monday Prudential Assurance Company Singapore (Pte) Ltd had sealed its Singapore $181 million purchase of seven storeys of the 30-storey "Prudential Tower".
Prudential, a unit of UK-based Prudential Corp plc, will make the first payment representing 20 percent of the total sale consideration, Keppel said in a statement.
When completed in 1998, Prudential Tower located in the heart of Singapore's financial district, will become the flagship building of Prudential Assurance Company, it said.
Prudential's chief executive officer, Tan Suee Chieh said the investment represents about 10 percent of the investments from its life fund and is part of the company's asset diversification strategy.
